the study of the regulation of the proliferation of cells of the liver and of hepatomas in vitro.
understanding the regulation of the growth and development of the liver.
the regulation of the growth of normal and neoplastic rat liver cells in culture.

calcium is an important factor in the regulation of liver cell proliferation.

calcium and cyclic AMP are involved in the regulation of cell proliferation, and that the control is lost in the neoplastic cell.

the loss of control of proliferation by tumorigenic cells is not a consequence of their ability to form tumors.
